column1: # Copy to /sdcard/p25_names.csv on the radio's SD card
# P25 CONFIG tab. The file is re-read on demand
# * name     - up to 23 chars; commas not allowed
# Blank lines and lines starting with '#' or ';' are ignored. A malformed
# line does not throw the whole file away; the P25 CONFIG tab reports which
# line was bad so you can fix that one row.
# Bounded at 256 entries and ~32 KB total. An oversized file is refused with
# a message on the panel rather than silently truncated - "the last 200 TGs
# are missing" reads exactly like "the file is fine but the radio is
# broken" and costs a debugging session.
